name: target_evades
proto: int target_evades(int attacker, int target, int kind)
purpose: Evasion roll shared by combat attacks and CAST spells (Ghidra params: param_1=kind, param_2=target roster index, param_3=attacker roster index). Kinds 0x30, 0x31 and >= 0x33 never miss (returns 0). Otherwise takes get_combat_stat(-1, attacker) and get_combat_stat(-1, target) and returns 1 (evaded) when random_damage_1_30() < (target_stat - attacker_stat + 30) / 2, else 0.
notes: vector 1778:099e; callers CAST c3be/c920/c9dc/cc18/dee0 and COMSUBS e2d4. The near call to 1000:7ec6 is the vector 1778:0746 = COMBAT b672 get_combat_stat.

name: dissipate_fields
purpose: Walks the 32 monster-table slots (0x5c5a, stride 8); each field object (tile & 0xfc == 0xe8, tiles 0xe8..0xeb) is removed with probability 16/256 (rand_range(0xff,0) < 0x10) via COMBAT remove_combatant(slot + 1). Called from SJOG dfbe (combat aftermath, vector 1778:0896).

name: print_combatant_name
purpose: Prints the name of roster entry ri: party members (flags 0x80) print the record name at 0x55a8 + member*0x20, monsters print g_creature_name_ptrs[type] (0x1856 + type*2).

name: print_missed
purpose: Miss message: when the spell-mode byte 0x588f is 0 prints the target's name then "missed!" (0x99aa); in spell mode prints "Failed!" (0x99a0).

0x588f.name: g_spell_mode
0x588f.meaning: save 0x2E9: non-zero while the current attack is a cast spell (value scales the aim confirmation tone)

name: monster_special_action
purpose: Monster special action at the start of its turn; returns 1 when the turn was consumed. Returns 0 for party members or while g_status_icon is 0x1c or 'N'. g_monster_flags bit 0x40 (possess): pick rand(0..31); if it is a party member with none of flags 0x3d then unless target_evades(0, t, ri) the member gets flag 1 (charmed), g_active_member becomes 0xff if it was that member, draw_status_window, name + "possessed!" (0x99b4) with play_sweep_noise(2,1000,0x7530,1,0xc1c), and an attacker of type 0x26 removes itself (remove_combatant(-1-ri)); the turn is used whether or not the roll succeeded. Else bit 0x800 with rand(0..255) < 0x20 toggles invisibility: anim tile 0 -> "reappears!" (0x99c2), flag 0x10 cleared, anim tile := tile; else "disappears!" (0x99ce), flag 0x10 set, anim tile 0. Else bit 0x400 with rand < 0x20: random_combat_cell() must succeed, combat_cell_free(g_dy,g_dx,0xd8) and add_combatant(g_party_z,g_dy,g_dx,0,0x26) != -1: name + "gates in a daemon!" (0x99dc), play_sweep_noise(0xf,1000,0x1388,1,0xac8), new slot tile/anim tile 0x16 during tile_transition_effect(g_dy,g_dx,0x1d8) then 0xd8.

name: print_hit_result
purpose: After-hit messages (Ghidra: param_1=attacker, param_2=target) driven by g_combat_state_flags (0x58a2). Bit 0 is cleared; if bit 0x20 was set: name + "grazed!" (0x99f2) and play_tone_sweep(0x28,1,2000,0x4b0). If bits 0x22 are still set they are cleared and the function returns. Target flags 0 or 0x20 -> name + "killed!" (0x99fc), bit 0 set. Else bit 4 -> name + "slept!" (0x9a06); bit 8 -> nothing; else name + (monster) monster_morale grade 1..4 -> "critical!" 0x9a64 / "heavily wounded!" 0x9a50 / "lightly wounded!" 0x9a3c / "barely wounded!" 0x9a2a (other grades nothing) or (party member) "hit!" 0x9a22 unless attacker != 0xff and the attacker's type is '-' (0x2d): "dragged under!" 0x9a10, tone, target flag 4 (swallowed), its slot's anim tile 0, animate_wait(4). Finally a party-member target redraws the status window and map view; bits 0xc are cleared.

0x58a2.name: g_combat_state_flags
0x58a2.meaning: per-attack result bits: 1 killed, 2 ?, 4 slept, 8 silent, 0x20 grazed/absorbed

name: dist_squared
proto: long dist_squared(int x2, int y2, int x1, int y1)
purpose: Squared distance (Ghidra: param_1=y1, param_2=x1, param_3=y2, param_4=x2): (y2-y1)^2 as a 32-bit long plus (x2-x1)^2 as a 16-bit int added to the low word; the high word is the high word of the y term. Only the low word is used.

name: cell_distance
proto: int cell_distance(int x2, int y2, int x1, int y1)
purpose: Integer square root of dist_squared (low word) by subtracting successive odd numbers; returns the count. Ghidra order (y1, x1, y2, x2). Vector 1778:0752 (COMBAT find_nearest_enemy).

name: roster_distance
purpose: cell_distance between roster entries a and b (Ghidra param_1=a, param_2=b) using their x (+6) and y (+7). Returns the distance in AX although Ghidra shows void; callers (COMBAT a4b6, e6e4, ebdc) use it. Vector 1778:063e.

name: aim_crosshair
purpose: Crosshair aiming loop for combatant ri (Ghidra param_1=range, param_2=ri). Sets g_crosshair_visible=1; initial crosshair = the roster entry stored in the attacker's monster slot +7 (last target) if < 32, flags without 0x30 and non-zero, slot tile non-zero and within range, else the attacker's own cell. Loop: refresh_map_view, read_command_key: 1/2/3/4 move W/E/N/S, 0xd3/0xd4/0xd5/0xd6 move NW/SW/NE/SE - a move is applied only when the new cell is inside 0..10 and cell_distance(attacker, new) <= range (the distance of the attempted move is kept as the result); Esc cancels; Enter, 'A' and space confirm when the crosshair is not on the attacker (put_char(10); in spell mode play_random_tones(700, mode*0x640+8000, 800)); space on the attacker's own cell cancels. On exit g_crosshair_visible=0; returns 0 (after a newline) when cancelled, else the last computed distance (which equals the attacker-to-crosshair distance since SI/DI are 0 on the confirm pass). The e7a2/e84c/e856/e860/e8ca/e8d2/e900 'functions' are fragments of this loop.
notes: vector 1778:09c2; reconstructed from the listing (Ghidra's C is a jump tangle)

name: fn_1000_e7a2_fragment
purpose: Fragment of aim_crosshair: NW-diagonal entry (SI=DI=-1) and the loop body LAB_e7a8.

name: fn_1000_e84c_fragment
purpose: Fragment of aim_crosshair: SE-diagonal entry (SI=DI=1). Ghidra labels it SHOPPES2_e84c because SHOPPES2 vector 1778:09fe targets this address in SHOPPES2.OVL.

name: fn_1000_e856_fragment
purpose: Fragment of aim_crosshair: NE-diagonal entry (DI=-1, SI=1).

name: fn_1000_e860_fragment
purpose: Fragment of aim_crosshair: SW-diagonal entry (DI=1, SI=-1), west entry (SI=-1), the space-on-own-cell cancel (e86a) and the confirm path (e883).

name: fn_1000_e8ca_fragment
purpose: Fragment of aim_crosshair: Esc path (cancel flag = 1).

name: fn_1000_e8d2_fragment
purpose: Fragment of aim_crosshair: dispatch for keys > 0x1b (0x20 space, 0x41 'A', 0xd3..0xd6 diagonals).

name: fn_1000_e900_fragment
purpose: Fragment of aim_crosshair: epilogue (g_crosshair_visible = 0; returns 0 with a newline on cancel, else the distance).

name: find_combatant_at
purpose: Returns the first roster index (0..31) whose x/y equal (x, y) (Ghidra param_1=y, param_2=x), whose monster-table slot anim tile (+1) is not 0xf4, whose flags contain 0x80 or 0x40 and neither 0x20 nor 0x04; -1 when none.

name: random_cell_near
purpose: Sets g_dx = x + rand(1..3) - 2 and g_dy = y + rand(1..3) - 2 (Ghidra param_1=y, param_2=x), re-rolling until both are within 0..10. The cell may equal (y, x) itself.

name: animate_missile
proto: int animate_missile(int attacker, int tx, int ty, int hit, int missile_tile)
purpose: Flies a missile from the attacker's roster cell to (ty, tx) (Ghidra: param_1=missile_tile, param_2=hit, param_3=ty, param_4=tx, param_5=attacker) and returns the roster entry struck or 0xffff. hit == 0: the target cell is replaced by random_cell_near(ty, tx) re-rolled until it differs from the attacker's own cell. g_attack_weapon 0x19 or 0x22: no animation; hit != 0 lands on (ty, tx) (a miss leaves the landed flag uninitialised). Otherwise animate_projectile(missile_tile, y, x, attacker_y, attacker_x): 0 (blocked) -> the cell becomes g_dy/g_dx where it stopped, else COMBAT check_room_trigger(y, x). Not landed: g_dx/g_dy = cell, return 0xffff. Else victim = find_combatant_at(y, x); weapons 0x13/0x33/0x34/0x35/0x36 add a field object add_combatant(g_party_z, y, x, 2, 0xea/0xe8/0xe9/0xea/0xeb). Returns victim when (g_spell_mode == 0 or hit != 0) and victim >= 0 and victim != g_active_combatant, else 0xffff; g_dx/g_dy = landing cell in all cases.

0x589d.name: g_attack_weapon
0x589d.meaning: weapon/spell id of the current attack, 0xff bare hands

0x589e.name: g_active_combatant
0x589e.meaning: roster index of the acting combatant

notes: vector 1778:0656; 1778:073a = COMBAT b3aa check_room_trigger. TODO(verify) uninitialised landed flag for weapon 0x19/0x22 misses (Rust uses 0)

name: use_missile_ammo
purpose: Ammunition bookkeeping after a ranged attack by the active combatant (Ghidra param_1=distance, param_2=weapon); nothing in spell mode. weapon < 0x17: only for 0x10 or 0x15..0x16 and only when distance >= 2: g_inventory[weapon] (0x57c0+weapon) is decremented, or when already 0 the item is unequipped from the active member (remove_equipped_item(weapon, member)). weapon 0x1a or 0x24: g_inventory[0x1b] (0x57db) is decremented; 0x1c: g_inventory[0x1d] (0x57dd); when the decremented count hits 0, SJOG remove_item_from_all_members(weapon) (vector 1778:088a) unequips it everywhere and its return (members affected) is added to g_inventory[weapon].

0x57db.name: g_inventory_1b
0x57db.meaning: g_inventory[0x1b]: ammunition count shared by weapons 0x1a and 0x24

notes: the item ids 0x1a/0x1c/0x24 -> ammo 0x1b/0x1d relation is taken from the code only

name: check_interference
purpose: m = g_monster_interference[ri]; if m != 0xff, roster m is live (flags != 0), combatant_side(m) != 0, flags & 0xc == 0, g_status_icon != 'T' and roster_distance(m, ri) == 1: newline, m's name, "interferes!" (0x9a70), returns 1. Else 0.

0x58a8.name: g_monster_interference
0x58a8.meaning: interfering roster index per combatant, 0xff none

name: ranged_attack
proto: void ranged_attack(int ri, int weapon, int missile_tile)
purpose: Ranged attack by roster entry ri (Ghidra param_1=missile_tile, param_2=weapon, param_3=ri). For weapons 0x1a, 0x1c, 0x24, 0x13, 0x11 check_interference(ri) may abort. Prints "Aim! " (0x9a7e), dist = aim_crosshair(g_item_range[weapon], ri); 0 = cancelled. Else play_tone_sweep(100,5,300,0x514); weapon 0x13 (flaming oil): g_inventory[0x13] (0x57d3) decremented or, when 0, remove_equipped_item(0x13, active member). Attacker's slot target (+7) := 0xff; victim = find_combatant_at(crosshair y, x): none -> hit = 1, else slot target := victim, use_missile_ammo(dist, weapon), hit = COMBAT attack_hits(weapon, -g_spell_mode, ri, victim). struck = animate_missile(missile_tile, hit, crosshair_y, crosshair_x, ri); landing cell saved from g_dy/g_dx. struck < 0: if a victim was aimed at, newline + print_missed(victim); else flash_monster(struck), newline, COMBAT deal_attack_damage(ri, struck), print_hit_result(ri, struck). Weapon 0x26 (magic axe) then animate_projectile(missile_tile, ri_y, ri_x, landing_y, landing_x) flies it back.

name: melee_attack
proto: void melee_attack(int attacker, int target, int weapon)
purpose: Melee blow (Ghidra param_1=weapon, param_2=target, param_3=attacker): play_tone_sweep(0x96,5,0x2ee,400), newline, hit = COMBAT attack_hits(weapon, -g_spell_mode, attacker, target); miss -> print_missed(target); hit -> flash_monster(target), COMBAT deal_attack_damage(attacker, target), print_hit_result(attacker, target).

name: attack_with
purpose: Attack by roster entry ri with weapon (0xff = bare hands / natural attack; Ghidra param_1=weapon, param_2=ri). weapon > 0x22 sets g_attack_is_spell (0x5890) = 1. Monsters: range = 0x159c[type] (1 treated as 0), missile tile = 0x15cc[type]; members: range = g_item_range[weapon] (0 for 0xff), missile = 0x169c[weapon]. Range 0: "Aim! " (0x9a84), dist = aim_crosshair(1, ri), victim = find_combatant_at(crosshair); dist == 0 or no victim -> "Nothing!\n" (0x9a8a); else attacker's slot target (+7) := victim and melee_attack(weapon, victim, ri). Range > 0: ranged_attack(missile, weapon, ri).

0x5890.name: g_attack_is_spell
0x5890.meaning: save 0x2EA: current attack is a spell

0x159c.name: g_monster_range
0x159c.meaning: attack range per creature type (1 = melee)

0x169c.name: g_item_missile_kind
0x169c.meaning: missile kind/tile per item id (passed to animate_projectile as kind)

name: attack_with_equipped
purpose: Attacks with one equipped item of the active combatant if it is a weapon (item != 0xff and g_item_attack[item] (0x15fc) != 0) (Ghidra param_1=weapon_count, param_2=item). With weapon_count > 1: g_spell_mode and g_attack_is_spell cleared, newline, item name (g_name_ptrs 0x17f6) and ":\n" (0x9a94). Then g_attack_weapon = item, "Attack-" (0x9a98), attack_with(item, g_active_combatant).

name: attack_command
purpose: The Attack command (Ghidra param_1=weapon_count, param_2=ri). Monster-side entry or weapon_count == 0: g_attack_weapon = 0xff, "Attack-" (0x9aa0), attack_with(0xff, ri). Else with weapon_count > 1 the cursor goes to column 0 of the current row and a space is printed; attack_with_equipped(count, item) for the member's helmet (0x55c1), left hand (0x55c3) and right hand (0x55c4) slots in turn (so two wielded weapons attack one after the other).

name: trace_line
proto: void trace_line(int x0, int y0, int x1, int y1, u8 *xbuf, u8 *ybuf)
purpose: Traces the pixel line from (x0,y0) to (x1,y1) into xbuf/ybuf (Ghidra param_1=ybuf, param_2=xbuf, param_3=y1, param_4=x1, param_5=y0, param_6=x0), one byte pair per step, 0xff terminated. slope = |(y1-y0)*100/(x1-x0)| (0x4b00 when vertical); outer loop per x step (accumulate slope), inner loop per 100 units of accumulator per y step while y steps remain; at most 0x148 points.

name: draw_missile
proto: void draw_missile(u8 px, u8 py, int phase, int kind, u8 *xbuf, u8 *ybuf)
purpose: Draws one frame of missile kind at pixel (px,py) in g_ui_color1 (Ghidra param_1=ybuf ptr, param_2=xbuf ptr, param_3=kind, param_4=phase 1..4, param_5=py, param_6=px). Shape tables: 0x2188 (kind 2) and 0x2198 (kinds > 2) hold signed (y,x) coordinate pairs; phase 1/3 offsets the y table by one byte, 2/4 the x table, with sign flips sy (phases 3,4) and sx (phases 2,3) giving four orientations. kind 0: up to nine 2-pixel horizontal dashes at the path points 4 back from the current one (draw_line(y, x+1, y, x)); kind 1: 5x5 blob of five vertical lines; kind 2: four lines from the table (stride 4); kinds 3..6: sparkle colour = g_ui_color0/2/3/4 + 8; kind 7: seven lines then plot_pixel at table entries +4,+6,+8. Sparkle: 48 pixels at (tbl[r]*sign + py, tbl[r']*sign' + px) using the 16-byte radius table 0x21ba and signs flipped by coin tosses.
notes: driver calls via ROOT set_color/draw_line/plot_pixel wrappers

name: animate_projectile
proto: int animate_projectile(int from_x, int from_y, int tx, int ty, int kind)
purpose: Animates a projectile of kind from combat cell (from_x,from_y) to (tx,ty) (Ghidra param_1=kind, param_2=ty, param_3=tx, param_4=from_y, param_5=from_x). copy_page(1,0) saves the screen; path buffers 0xa728 (x) / 0xa872 (y) filled with 0xff then trace_line between cell centres (cell*16+16). Frame step 13 pixels (6 in settlements 1..0x20, 8 for kind 7 elsewhere); kind 0 starts 4 points in. Per frame: phase = (phase&3)+1, pixel_to_view_cell(py,px) (g_dx == -1 -> return 1), draw_missile, delay_loop(0x28,1), copy_rect_between_pages(py+15,(px&0xf8)+15,py-8,(px&0xf8)-8,0,1) restores the background, advance; x pointer past 0xa872 or a 0xff entry -> return 1. If view_tile_missile_passable(g_dy,g_dx) fails and the cell is not the shooter's own: return 0 (g_dx/g_dy = blocking cell). Returns 1 when the target is reached.
